subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: A: I've got a new boyfriend. B: A new boyfriend? This reply is...
questions.explanation: An echo question repeats a word or phrase from the speaker to show surprise or interest.
questions.explanation_ar: سؤال الصدى يعيد كلمة أو عبارة من كلام المتحدث لإظهار المفاجأة أو الاهتمام.

questions.question: A: He can't speak English. B: Can't he? This reply is...
questions.explanation: A reply question repeats the auxiliary and pronoun instead of a word from the statement.
questions.explanation_ar: سؤال الردّ يعيد الفعل المساعد والضمير لا كلمة من الجملة.

questions.question: What does an echo question do?
options: it repeats part of the statement
options_en: it repeats part of the statement
questions.explanation: The echo picks one element of what was said and turns it into a surprised question.
questions.explanation_ar: الصدى يلتقط عنصراً واحداً مما قيل ويحوّله إلى سؤال مفاجأة.

questions.question: What does a reply question use?
options: a main verb and an object
an article and a noun here
options_en: a main verb and an object
an article and a noun here
questions.explanation: The reply question is a short auxiliary plus pronoun that mirrors the original tense.
questions.explanation_ar: سؤال الردّ فعل مساعد قصير مع ضمير يعكس زمن الجملة الأصلية.

questions.question: He had left. Which reply question matches?
questions.explanation: The reply question must copy the auxiliary of the statement, and had stays had.
questions.explanation_ar: سؤال الردّ يجب أن ينسخ فعل الجملة المساعد، و had تبقى had.

questions.question: A: I'm broke. B: How come? The phrase means...
questions.explanation: How come is an informal way of asking why something happened.
questions.explanation_ar: How come طريقة غير رسمية للسؤال عن السبب.

questions.question: Both echo and reply questions are used to...
questions.explanation: Both keep the conversation going by showing that the listener is following and interested.
questions.explanation_ar: كلاهما يبقي الحوار مستمراً بإظهار أن المستمع يتابع ومهتم.

questions.question: What does a flat intonation make you sound?
questions.explanation: Without the rising pattern the question sounds flat, so the listener seems uninterested.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا نمط النبرة الصاعد يبدو السؤال مسطحاً، فيظهر المستمع غير مهتم.
